info.name: CLD376 - Midterm Merged Collection (EC2)
info.description: Complete merged Postman collection for CLD376 Car Repair Shop System on AWS EC2 ({{gateway}}). Matches the report document exactly 1-to-1.

request.description: Customer self-registration with default customer role.
Logs in as manager and auto-saves managerToken and managerId.
Logs in as customer 1 and auto-saves customerToken and customerId.
Logs in as customer 2 and auto-saves customer2Token and customer2Id.
Logs in as mechanic 1 and auto-saves mechanicToken and mechanicId.
Logs in as mechanic 2 and auto-saves mechanic2Token and mechanic2Id.
Returns authenticated user identity and claims from gateway headers.
Re-verifies token signature and claims.
Public request returning all catalog services with integer cents prices.
Load balancer test call 1 (expects catalog-a or catalog-b).
Load balancer test call 2 (alternates instance).
Load balancer test call 3 (alternates instance).
Load balancer test call 4 (alternates instance).
Manager creates a new catalog service.
Manager changes the price of the service created in 2.6. Expects 200 with the new price (5500).
Manager deletes the service created in 2.6. Expects 204 with no body. Run 2.6 again to create another one.
Customer registers a vehicle. Auto-saves vehicleId.
Customer 1 lists vehicles and sees only their own. Expects 200.
Customer 1 changes the color of the car from Step 1. Expects 200 with the new color. Keeps the plate used in Step 1 (CAR-379154); change it here if you changed it there.

item.name: Step 1c - Setup - Customer Adds Spare Vehicle

request.description: SETUP for Step 1d, no screenshot needed. Creates a throwaway car with a unique plate. Saves spareVehicleId.
Customer 1 deletes the throwaway car. Expects 204 with no body.
Customer books service for their vehicle. Auto-saves bookingId.

item.name: Step 2a - Setup - Customer Makes Spare Booking (stays pending)

request.description: SETUP for Steps 2b and 2c, no screenshot needed. Customer 1 makes a second booking that stays pending. Saves spareBookingId.
Manager sees the pending queue (the Step 2 booking and the spare one). Expects 200.
Manager deletes the spare booking. Expects 204 with no body.
Manager approves the pending booking.
Manager creates work order and assigns mechanic. Auto-saves workOrderId.
Mechanic sets work order status to in_progress.
Mechanic logs a diagnostic finding note.

item.name: Step 7 - Mechanic Adds Work Done Note

request.description: Mechanic logs completed work note.

item.name: Step 7a - Manager Reads Notes for Work Order

request.description: Manager reads all notes of this work order. Expects 200 with both notes (finding and work_done).
Mechanic 1 edits the finding note from Step 6 (type and text only). Expects 200 with the new text.

item.name: Step 7c - Setup - Mechanic Adds Spare Note

request.description: SETUP for Step 7d, no screenshot needed. Mechanic 1 adds a throwaway note (the work order is still in_progress). Saves spareNoteId.
Manager deletes the throwaway note. Expects 204 with no body.
Mechanic marks work order completed and sets timestamp.

item.name: Step 9 - Customer Checks Work Order Status

request.description: Customer inspects work order to verify completed status.
Billing calls Work Orders cross-service, verifies completion, and computes total server-side (10500 = $105.00). Auto-saves invoiceId.
Customer reads their generated invoice.
Manager records payment confirmation.
Expects 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS.

item.name: N2 - No token on protected route

request.description: Expects 401 NO_TOKEN.
Expects 401 INVALID_TOKEN.

item.name: N4 - Customer tries to add catalog service

request.description: Expects 403 FORBIDDEN.

item.name: N5 - Mechanic tries to create invoice

request.description: Expects 403 FORBIDDEN.
Expects 403 FORBIDDEN (ownership check).

item.name: N7 - Mechanic 2 updates Mechanic 1 work order

request.description: Expects 403 FORBIDDEN (assigned mechanic check).

item.name: N8 - Register with role manager in body

request.description: Expects 201, but role is safely forced to customer.
Expects 400 VEHICLE_NOT_OWNED.

item.name: N10a - Setup - Customer 1 makes a new booking (leave it pending)

request.description: SETUP for N10, no screenshot needed. Customer 1 books a service and the booking stays pending. Saves pendingBookingId (a BOOKING id).

item.name: N10 - Work order from unapproved booking

request.description: Expects 400 BOOKING_NOT_APPROVED. Uses pendingBookingId from N10a (a booking id, not a user id).

item.name: N11a - Setup - Manager approves the pending booking

request.description: SETUP for N11, no screenshot needed. Approves the booking that N10 used.

item.name: N11b - Setup - Manager creates a work order from that booking

request.description: SETUP for N11, no screenshot needed. Saves inProgressWorkOrderId (a WORK ORDER id).

item.name: N11c - Setup - Mechanic 1 sets the work order to in_progress (do NOT complete it)

request.description: SETUP for N11, no screenshot needed. The work order must stay unfinished.

item.name: N11 - Invoice for incomplete work order

request.description: Expects 400 WORK_ORDER_NOT_COMPLETED. Uses inProgressWorkOrderId from N11b (a work order id, not a user id).

item.name: N12 - Duplicate invoice on same work order

request.description: Expects 409 DUPLICATE (enforced by Mongo unique index).
